_comment: Four rounds of the same TOCTOU class at four different call sites, plus one unrelated finding. Modelled on PR #291: no single FILE reaches three rounds, so the file-level detector never fires; the class does. `sources` keeps the classifier off the disk.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the session after the await**

The session row is read, then `writeSessionMessage` is called after an await, so a container that exits in between wins the race and the write lands on a session that no longer accepts it.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recheck the session after awaiting the read**

Same race as the routing path: the state is read before the await and `writeSessionMessage` runs after it, with nothing revalidating the row in between.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the destination after the mailbox await**

`wakeContainer` is invoked after an await on a destination read, so a concurrent archive is not seen and the wake row is written against a dead container.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recheck the closure set after the asynchronous clear**

The closure set is captured before the await and `writeSessionMessage` runs against it afterwards; a session archived during the clear is still written to, which is the same race again.

**<sub><sub>![P3 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P3-blue?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat an absent config value as empty**

A missing entry is currently undefined here and reads as a null downstream; default it to an empty list instead.
